commands.label: Execute native VBScript in the Windows console host

program.vbs.content_utf8:
Option Explicit
Public Sub HelloWorld()
    Debug.Print "Hello, World!"
End Sub
Dim Debug
Set Debug = New ImmediateConsole
Call HelloWorld()
Class ImmediateConsole
    Public Sub Print(Value)
        WScript.StdOut.WriteLine CStr(Value)
    End Sub
End Class

toolchain: Microsoft Windows Script Host VBScript via cscript.exe
semantic_scope: The Microsoft VBScript interpreter executed the unchanged VBA routine in the shared language subset. A console fixture for the VBA Debug object received the exact Debug.Print argument.
path_normalization: Temporary paths use stable placeholders. Source hashes refer to the repository files listed in artifact_sha256.
